# WolfDex

> Premium multichain decentralized exchange on LitVM LiteForge Testnet (Chain ID 4441). Swap, provide liquidity, farm, launch ERC-20 tokens, and play on-chain casino games.

WolfDex is a full-featured DEX with smart routing, limit orders, MEV protection, MasterChef-style yield farms, a one-click ERC-20 launchpad, and eight provably on-chain casino games. All trades and bets settle on LitVM.
